_note: Documented estimates, not stopwatch measurements. If the group times a real manual mapping, replace the numbers and set measured to true.

manual.basis: Seven frameworks with 235 requirements. Reading one control and scanning each catalog takes about 2 to 3 minutes per framework, so about 20 minutes per control (A2 spent similar effort to map only 2 or 3 requirements per control). Working out requirement status for 235 requirements from 25 control statuses and ranking the gaps by risk takes about 2.5 hours.
manual.description: Analyst reads each control, searches framework catalogs, records mappings, then works out requirement coverage by hand

ai_assisted.basis: The Ollama run produced 74 suggestions for 25 controls, about 3 per control. Each has a title and a one line rationale, so accepting or rejecting one takes about 1 minute.
ai_assisted.description: Analyst reviews and approves each AI suggested mapping; AI runtime is measured automatically from the run log
